question: How do I schedule a property viewing?
answer: You can request a viewing by providing your preferred date and time through this chat, or by calling our office. A member of our team will confirm the appointment and accompany you to the property. (Note: this is sample data for demonstration purposes.)

question: What documents do I need to buy a property in Dubai?
answer: Typically, buyers need a valid passport copy, proof of address, and bank statements or a mortgage pre-approval letter. Additional documents may be required depending on the transaction. Our team will guide you through the full checklist once you proceed. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: What documents are required to rent a property?
answer: Tenants generally need a valid passport copy, UAE visa copy (if applicable), Emirates ID, and proof of income or employment. Specific requirements may vary by landlord. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: What are your agency fees?
answer: Our standard agency fee for rentals is 5% of the annual rent. For sales, the buyer's agent fee is typically 2% of the purchase price. Fees may vary — please confirm with our team for your specific transaction. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: What are your office hours?
answer: Our office is open Sunday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We are closed on Fridays and public holidays. You can still reach us via this chat outside office hours. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: Do you offer payment plans?
answer: Some of our off-plan and select ready properties offer developer payment plans, which may include post-handover installments. The specific terms depend on the developer and project. Please ask our team for details on a particular listing. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: What is the difference between off-plan and ready properties?
answer: Off-plan properties are still under construction and are purchased before completion, often at lower prices with flexible payment plans. Ready properties are completed and available for immediate move-in or handover. Both options have their advantages depending on your goals. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: How do I book a viewing?
answer: Simply let us know the property you are interested in and your preferred date and time. Our team will confirm the viewing within a few hours and send you the meeting details. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: What happens after I book a property?
answer: After booking, you will sign a reservation form and pay a deposit (usually 10% for sales). Our team will guide you through the remaining steps including the sales agreement, NOC, and transfer at the Dubai Land Department. For rentals, we prepare the tenancy contract and Ejari registration. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: What are service charges and maintenance fees?
answer: Service charges cover building maintenance, common area upkeep, security, and amenities. They are set annually by the building management or developer and vary by community and unit size. Our team can provide the estimated service charges for any listed property. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: Are pets allowed in the properties?
answer: Pet policies vary by building and community. Some buildings welcome pets with certain size or breed restrictions, while others do not permit them. We recommend confirming the pet policy for your chosen property with our team before signing. (Note: this is sample data.)

question: Is parking included with the property?
answer: Most apartments include one designated parking space. Larger units or villas may include two or more. Some buildings also offer additional parking for purchase or rent. Parking details are available for each listing upon request. (Note: this is sample data.)
